## 5d. Detector-independent test: is the evidence state of a stored-wrong read identical to a state at which K was right?

Evidence states recomputed from the cached observation tables (states_s0.py); they agree with the recorded 'same' action on 100.000 % of reads. A stored-wrong read whose evidence state is identical to a state at which K was right (at any FUTURE commit, or s0) is an observation-completeness violation: identical recorded evidence, different truth — no judge can be right at both. The remaining stored-wrong reads have evidence that differs from every K-right state, so a miss there is a judge error (or an indirect cause the judge could not infer from the visible change).
